body:
## Pensieve 0.6.9

### Fixed
- **Dialogs no longer get stuck in the sidebar.** With a background picture, a dialog opened from the sidebar (such as New project) was squeezed into the sidebar and cut off. Dialogs now always open in the middle of the window.
- **A project in the sidebar opens where you were in that project.** It could open a page of another project you had reached from it (by Search or a link). Pages and the phone's tabs had the same problem; places remembered wrongly before this update are ignored.
- **Switching between ideas or projects no longer carries an open edit over** to the next one.
- On a Mac, swiping sideways through a wide table no longer jumps back a page.

### Download

| Your system | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 / 11 | **Pensieve-Setup-0.6.9.exe** |
| Mac with Apple Silicon | **Pensieve-0.6.9-mac-arm64.zip** |
| Mac with Intel | **Pensieve-0.6.9-mac-x64.zip** |
| Linux (64-bit) | **Pensieve-0.6.9-linux-x86_64.AppImage** or **Pensieve-0.6.9-linux-amd64.deb** |
| Android 8+ (HarmonyOS via 卓易通) | **Pensieve-0.6.9-android.apk** |
| iPhone / iPad (iOS 15+) | **Pensieve-0.6.9-ios-unsigned.ipa** — install with Sideloadly or AltStore ([how](https://photonghost308.github.io/pensieve-app/#ios-install)) |

Already using Pensieve? It updates itself (Settings → General → Updates). Your notes stay as they are.
